initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);

steps.label: listAll
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var V3=cam.position.constructor; var wp=new V3(); var out=[]; sc.traverse(function(o){ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; var n=o.name||o.type||'?'; if(n.indexOf('Grass_chunk')===0) return; if(n.indexOf('Foliage_chunk')===0) return; o.getWorldPosition(wp); var pp=wp.clone(); pp.project(cam); var sx=(pp.x*0.5+0.5)*1280, sy=(-pp.y*0.5+0.5)*720; if(sx>=0&&sx<=1280&&sy>=0&&sy<=720&&pp.z>-1&&pp.z<1.2){ out.push({n:n.slice(0,32), sx:Math.round(sx), sy:Math.round(sy), z:+pp.z.toFixed(3), y:+wp.y.toFixed(1)}); } }); out.sort(function(a,b){ return a.sx-b.sx; }); return JSON.stringify(out.slice(0,50)); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.label: hideNearWuAll
steps.js: (function(){ try { var wu=window.__labWuMesh; if(!wu) return 'no-wu'; var e=window.__experience; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var V3=wu.position.constructor; var wp=new V3(); var hidden=[]; sc.traverse(function(o){ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; var n=o.name||''; if(n==='__lab_wu_carpet__'||n==='__lab_wu_ground__') return; if(n.indexOf('Grass_chunk')===0) return; if(n.indexOf('__lab_')===0) return; o.getWorldPosition(wp); var dx=wp.x-wu.position.x, dy=wp.y-wu.position.y, dz=wp.z-wu.position.z; if(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz < 9){ o.visible=false; hidden.push(n.slice(0,28)); } }); return JSON.stringify(hidden); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.label: render
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e.revealMesh) e.revealMesh.visible=false; if(window.__labAurora) window.__labAurora.visible=false; var r=e.engine.renderer.instance; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; r.render(sc,cam); return 'ok'; } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()
